title: Jawn's Vanilla+
description: Truly vanilla+ with a focus on Create
body:
![Jawn's Vanilla Plus](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/03f04ce81a5e0a980cc70eb590e022d24b7a5f53.png)
<center>A modpack designed to create a greater depth to the game, without ruining the vanilla feel</center>

## 🍦 Vanilla+
The main purpose of this modpack is to create a more refined vanilla+ experience than I've been able to find in existing modpacks. Mainly focused around the [Create mod](https://modrinth.com/mod/create) and it's addons, this pack offers minimal changes to the typical gameplay of vanilla Minecraft while introducing many more things to build and explore.

## ⚡ Performance
A number of performance mods have been included as well, which should make it possible for people with older or weaker computers to play. It also loads relatively quickly, despite being a forge pack.

## ✨ Quality of life
The final consideration is quality of life. [Tom's simple storage](https://modrinth.com/mod/toms-storage) will make organizing your items a breeze, [backpacks](https://modrinth.com/mod/sophisticated-backpacks) have been added to help with inventory management, [villagers can now be rerolled more easily](https://modrinth.com/mod/trade-refresh), and your pets will make for [better and more useful companions](https://modrinth.com/mod/domestication-innovation).


### The following included mods will impact gameplay
<details>
<summary>Core mods</summary>

- [Create](https://modrinth.com/mod/create)
  - Several addons also included
- [Tom's Simple Storage](https://modrinth.com/mod/toms-storage)
- [Farmer's Delight](https://modrinth.com/mod/farmers-delight)
- [Domestication Innovation](https://modrinth.com/mod/domestication-innovation)
- [Ecologics](https://modrinth.com/mod/ecologics)
- [Sophisticated Backpacks](https://modrinth.com/mod/sophisticated-backpacks)
- [Xaero's Minimap](https://modrinth.com/mod/xaeros-minimap)
- [YUNG's Better Xxx](https://modrinth.com/mod/yungs-api)
  - Reworks for most available structures

</details>
